auth.about_subtitle: DocPad is a centralized, secure workspace for teams to create, organize, edit, and share documents in one place.
auth.about_feat_1_desc: Write documents directly in the built-in editor or upload files with folder organization and favorites.
auth.about_feat_2_desc: Organize members into teams with flexible visibility (Public, Team, Private) and granular permissions.
auth.about_feat_3_desc: Encrypt sensitive files and generate shareable links with optional password protection and instant revocation.
auth.about_feat_4_desc: Track document history, monitor storage quotas, and get notified when teammates upload or share files.
